name: Mama-san Volley ((Chichi Yuremansee))
original_name: ママさんバレー((乳ゆれまんせー))
source:
Main character gets to coach a small weak volley team consisting of adult women. For two weeks he's going to supervise three lagging behind members in private training sessions. Is it even possible to win with such team?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公受邀担任一支弱小排球队的教练，队员都是成年女性。接下来的两周里，他将通过私人训练指导三名落后队员。这样的队伍真的有可能获胜吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
